name: Hydraulic Erosion
desc: Rain carves a living mountain range — droplets incise dendritic drainage into a heightfield while tectonic uplift pushes back, so ridges sharpen, rivers capture one another, and whole ranges rise and wear away over minutes.

energy.doc: erosion rate, rainfall and relief exaggeration

density.doc: droplet count and brightness of the drainage network

speed.doc: rate multiplier on growth and process time

relief.doc: vertical exaggeration of the shaded relief
